line: Every private thing you've ever typed into ChatGPT trains its next model — and that's the default.
It's not just chat history. The files you upload and the replies you get back become training data too.
Switch it off, and every new conversation stays out of training for good.
But it only protects what happens after. Nothing you already sent ever gets pulled back out.
There's a separate mode that skips training and history every time, with nothing left to keep track of.
It takes about ten seconds, one time, to switch on.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
